name: Hud
lead: A layout on one player's screen, from `player.ui.show`. `hud.<id>` is the item with that id.

functions.name: set
functions.description: A value per id: a number is a fill, a string a label's words, true or false whether it shows. An unknown id is an error that lists the ids.

functions.name: destroy
functions.description: Takes it off the player's screen.
